name: session-radar
description: A side pane with this session's peer name, the other open sessions you can message, which of them wait for you, edit-conflict warnings for you and your agents, context fill, cost, rate limits, tokens and tool-call stats.

finishedNotices.title: Finished notices
finishedNotices.description: Which sessions tell you when they finish: only those in this session's project folder, or every open session in any project.

agentWarnings.title: Warn agents about edit conflicts
agentWarnings.description: When another session that is still working edited a file moments ago, refuse this session's first edit of it once, naming that session, so the agent re-reads the file and can message the other session first.
